## LendLoop - Daily Overdue Reminders
Runs daily at 09:00 UTC (or manually).
1. Fetch overdue candidates from Convex
2. Per loan: claim reminder - only `claimed` is emailed (SMTP or MOCKED); everything else is skipped
3. Report each reminder, then record run counts at /automation/runs (also for empty runs)

Re-running the same day is safe: Convex returns `duplicate` for reminders already sent.
